description: The Notes module: folders, favorites, tree, block editor, creating/editing note content, or using note tools.
detection_hint: note, notes module, folder, favorite, star, sidebar, tree, breadcrumb, block editor, create note, edit note, append, read note, list notes

injection.system_prompt_fragment: Notes are block documents. Work like a code editor: search_notes to find a note/block, outline_note to map it cheaply (gives short block ids + a version), read_note to pull only the blocks you need, then edit_note to apply a batch of surgical ops (set_text, replace, insert, delete, move, convert, set_checked) addressing blocks by their short id. Pass expected_version from outline/read into edit_note so you don't overwrite changes. create_note for new notes; manage_note to rename/move/favorite/delete. Prefer small reads and targeted edits over rewriting whole notes. Tool results are JSON: ok, code, message, data.
